title: terminal.read input
description: One bounded read of real terminal session content captured daemon-side from the declared session target. The selector names an operator-visible terminal session; it never grants input injection or command execution. The capture is the bounded viewport of the resolved live target — never an unchecked full-scroll dump; content beyond maxBytes is truncated, and the truncation is reported, never silent.

session.description: Zellij terminal session name of the daemon's bound live terminal target (an operator terminal). Not an Odin session id, run id, or delegated child session id; derive it from the bound target rather than guessing.

maxBytes.description: Byte ceiling for the captured viewport content; captures beyond it are truncated and reported, never silently dropped.
